authority.evidence: Accepted explicit spawn configuration; no independent backend attestation claimed.

bases.forge_workbench: All Workbench application source already in main; UI branch only differs in three deployment documentation files.

C4: Independent review and new narrowly named verification tests only; do not modify owned implementation files without C0 assignment

capabilities.reason: Execution is owned by the Mediflow supervisor; partial optimizer/RNG resume is unsupported.

storage.root: Operator-configured private telemetry root; never returned in APIs
storage.writer: One owner per attempt stream; separate seq per steps/resources/events. Append UTF-8 JSONL. Atomic replacement of JSON snapshots. Do not truncate originals. Default append+flush each update; fsync checkpoint/end and configurable cadence.
storage.seq: Positive increasing integer within (campaign_id,run_id,attempt_id,producer,stream); no reuse. A stream has exactly one producer.
storage.stream_epoch: Stable SHA256 of attempt identity+stream+producer; bridge additionally detects inode replacement/truncation and requires reset.
storage.privacy: No prompts, answers, generated text, images, tokens, secret values or filesystem paths in API records. IDs are logical identifiers, not paths.

identity.api_run_id: mf- + first 24 lowercase hex characters of SHA256(canonical JSON [campaign_id,job_id,run_id,attempt_id]); API id represents one attempt, preserving original run and attempt IDs.
identity.nullable: Absent/unknown scalar is JSON null, never 0. All floats must be finite or normalized null with reason.

envelope_required.emitted_at: UTC ISO8601 or null for historical observation with no original timestamp
envelope_required.observed_at: UTC ISO8601 conversion/read observation time; live may equal emitted_at
envelope_required.source_artifact: null or {artifact_id: logical name, sha256: hex64}; never a private path

identity.availability: Object keyed by missing/derived metric field. Each entry {available:boolean,reason:string|null,provenance:live_measured|historical_reconstructed|derived|unmeasured}. Non-null inherited envelope provenance is default for measured fields.

fields.train_loss: number|null; arithmetic mean of already computed per-example target-token-mean losses in this actual update

step.prohibited: No new forward/backward, RNG draw, sample-order change, optimizer/scheduler change, per-update synchronize or re-computation of loss.

resource.policy: Read NVML/nvidia-smi/proc without initializing CUDA. Failures remain null with reasons and backoff. No historical time-series invention. Energy optional derived only with explicit measured interval/coverage.

fields.message: Sanitized bounded text or null; default fixed safe message
fields.details: Allowlisted scalar metadata only; no traceback, raw arbitrary dict, private paths or model output

summary.note: Do not turn total wall_seconds into step durations or pure training time.

evaluation.file: evaluations.json is {evaluations:[records]}; absence means not run

fields.metrics: Original evaluator aggregate metrics object, sanitized allowlist; names unchanged
fields.subgroups: array of OPEN/CLOSED, modality or image-ablation aggregate records; preserve original labels

evaluation.comparison: Only compare matching non-null data_hash, protocol, protocol_version, precision, model/task cohort and split. Missing identity makes comparability unknown, not equal. Keep evaluator denominators; never calculate clinical accuracy.

dataset.registration: Admin-approved immutable reference manifest; HTTP does not accept filesystem paths. Catalog enumerated by bridge from configured root/datasets. POST accepts only manifest_id. Original canonical records remain Mediflow-owned.
dataset.rules: No canonical transformation, resplit or native image preprocessing. Retain original medvlm.dataset.v1 source references and hashes. No raw input/supervision fields in HTTP. Paginate metadata index using persisted offset index; do not rescan full raw dataset on each summary/request. Reference registration can expose count/hash without an index. No artificial 1000-row/128KiB limit; metadata page remains bounded.

api.auth: Existing Forge _authorize; GET remote_view gate; POST session+CSRF+remote_control. No anonymous bypass.
api.service: C1 implements mediflow.MediflowBridge(root, db_path=None), refresh(), snapshot(), capabilities(), dispatch(method,path,query=None,payload=None), close(). root is trusted Path; db_path optional bridge SQLite path outside source records. refresh() idempotently ingests bounded incremental records and returns health object; dispatch() calls refresh as needed. snapshot() returns {mode:"mediflow",source:"external_mediflow",capabilities:capabilities(),campaigns:[],runs:[]} with the exact API run_record shape for root assembly (do not masquerade as legacy run types). dispatch receives full path and query dict[str,str] and returns JSON object. Raise existing Forge DashboardError with status. C0 owns HTTP/auth/routes/CLI and response status. close() closes bridge resources only, never signals workers.

endpoints.GET /runs/<id>/export?format=json|csv: JSON object for json; C1 export_rows(id) optional for C0 csv response. Export aggregate metrics only, no raw data.
endpoints.POST /datasets/register: payload {manifest_id:logical dataset ID}; response {dataset:dataset_manifest,registered:true}; C0 HTTP 201

api.run_record: {id,campaign_id,job_id,run_id,attempt_id,source,model,task,seed,status,phase,historical,optimizer_step,total_updates,samples_processed,samples_total,train_loss,last_emitted_at,observed_at,stale,telemetry_complete,training_succeeded,reload_succeeded,evaluation_completed,data_hash,scientific_recipe_hash,code_sha,eval_protocol,precision,cohort_id}. Unknown values null. last train_loss is last step, not cumulative mean.
api.stream_page: {items:[],next_after_seq:int,has_more:bool,stream_epoch:string,telemetry_complete:bool|null}; seq means original stream sequence, not shared across streams. All records one attempt/producer.
api.cursor_policy: Client keeps separate cursor+epoch for steps/resources/events, requests after_seq strictly greater, dedupes by (id,stream_epoch,seq). Partial trailing line withheld, raw never truncated. Bridge persists file offsets/dedupe in separate SQLite DB. Inode rotation/truncation or incompatible epoch yields DashboardError mediflow_cursor_reset HTTP409; UI clears affected chart/cursor and reloads. Duplicate same seq/content ignored; conflicting seq/content recorded as integrity error, never silently overwrite.
api.staleness: stale means running stream has no new observed activity beyond threshold, not failed. Browser disconnected distinct from stale. Terminal historical runs are not stale for lack of new telemetry.
api.errors: Standard Forge DashboardError envelope; ids restricted to mf-[a-f0-9]{24}, dataset/catalog IDs [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}. No ID-to-filesystem interpolation. Resolve containment and reject symlink escape on all manifest/index files.

historical_mapping.v6: Reconstruct from train.metrics.json or metrics.json with config identity and verified source hash. Validate len(example_losses)==sum(update_example_counts), each count positive, number counts==optimizer_steps; never force divisor16. Boundaries are cumulative actual counts. train_loss=sum(losses[start:end])/count; batch_examples=count; samples_processed=end. learning_rates[i] -> lr_used; next entry or final_learning_rate -> lr_next. gradient_norms_before_clip[i] -> gradient_norm_before_clip. example_supervised_tokens sliced by same boundaries; cumulative sums exact. sequence_tokens only total if no per-example records available; step sequence_tokens null with reason. Historical peak CUDA belongs summary, never copied as each step allocated memory. Missing dates/durations/resource series stay null.
historical_mapping.v6_invariants: Text7997=499*16+13 =>500updates; VQA1979=123*16+11 =>124updates. Whole-run loss is weighted by batch_examples, not unweighted mean of step means.
historical_mapping.legacy_events: training/runner.py optimizer_update event: step->optimizer_step, loss->train_loss, samples->batch_examples, gradient_norm->gradient_norm_before_clip, target_tokens->supervised_tokens, seconds->step_wall_seconds with documented legacy update host-wall scope. IMPORTANT lr is AFTER scheduler.step(), so map to lr_next, leave lr_used null unless authoritative previous/config evidence proves it. append_event timestamp may be used if present, otherwise null.
historical_mapping.artifact_proof: Hash original bytes without mutation. Supplied receipt hash must match or reject import. If no external receipt expected hash exists, record computed hash but receipt_verified=null; do not claim independent verification. Import should be idempotent by source hash+logical identity; historical output in separate integration-owned root.
historical_mapping.evaluation: Adapter preserves evaluation/metrics.py aggregate names and denominators, subgroup metrics and source receipt; no scoring/parser changes.

acceptance.candidate: CPU contract/security/history/UI tests and exact source commits; pending GPU validation explicit.
acceptance.release: TRAINING_OWNER text and VLM real probes, two distinct measured steps/losses each in browser, refresh preservation, separate save/reload/eval evidence, source hash reconciliation, measured latency and telemetry on/off overhead. Only C0 issues ready; do not mark GPU/browser success from fixtures.

probe_design.path: Existing campaign_gpu_smoke.py 20-update native T1 text and V1 VLM path, instrumented with same writer; sequential under unchanged real GPU lease. Do not create new trainer or relax smoke identity checks.
probe_design.preparation: C2 may prepare immutable configs CPU-only using existing build_config and pinned candidate source files/hash, original model/data freeze and original data root lock. source_files must include telemetry.py so source hash covers actual instrumentation. Owner validates launch/lease and executes.
probe_design.requested_evidence: Per probe at least two distinct measured optimizer steps and losses, saved checkpoint and fresh reload receipt, bridge/browser arrival and refresh, process/cgroup independence; on/off overhead CPU first then owner GPU if feasible. No 500-update full run needed for candidate probe.
